label: Trustpilot
description: Send Trustpilot review invitations to customers after their orders. Requires a paid Trustpilot plan with the API module (Enterprise includes it). Create an API application in Trustpilot Business → Integrations → Developers → APIs to get the API key and secret.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the API key and secret, and lists your invitation templates

actions.label: Invite past orders
actions.hint: Sends invitations for orders placed before the app was installed

modal.title: Invite past orders
modal.description: Sends a Trustpilot invitation right away for each order placed since this date that reached the "Send invitation when" step and wasn't invited yet. Runs in the background.

fields.label: Orders placed since
fields.description: Trustpilot accepts invitations for recent purchases. Keep this to the last few weeks.

fields.label: API secret
fields.description: Shown next to the API key

fields.label: Business unit ID
fields.description: Your Trustpilot business profile ID. Leave empty and run Test connection to look it up by your store's domain.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns off all invitations without uninstalling the app

fields.label: Invitations
fields.description: Customers get a Trustpilot email inviting them to review your store.

fields.label: Days to wait
fields.description: Trustpilot sends the email this many days later. 0 sends it right away.

fields.label: Sender name
fields.description: Shown as the sender of the email. Empty: Trustpilot's default.

fields.label: Reply-to email
fields.description: Where customer replies go. Empty: Trustpilot's default.

fields.label: Language
fields.description: Locale of the email and review page, e.g. en-US, en-GB, de-DE

fields.label: Template ID
fields.description: Empty: your default template. Test connection lists template IDs.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Comma-separated tags added to service reviews, e.g. swell, webshop

fields.label: Redirect URL
fields.description: Page customers see after writing their review. Empty: Trustpilot's page.

fields.label: Product reviews
fields.description: Also ask customers to review the products they bought. Requires Trustpilot product reviews on your plan.

fields.label: Invite to product reviews
fields.description: Items with a SKU and a product name are added to the invitation

fields.label: Product template ID
fields.description: Empty: your default product review template

fields.label: Product page URL
fields.description: Use {slug} or {id}, e.g. https://shop.example.com/products/{slug}. Empty: your store URL + /products/{slug}.
